spanish: Y dos tablas harás para los ángulos del tabernáculo en los dos lados posteriores.
grammarChanges: Translated mishkán as the Spanish common noun tabernáculo instead of leaving it transliterated.
Replaced los fondos with los dos lados posteriores to restore the feminine dual and avoid the bottoms sense.
Replaced the bare indefinite a ángulos with the definite para los ángulos del tabernáculo to keep the construct corners-of sense and avoid reading as making them into angles.
